IdentityBearer.description: Identity token (global scope) issued by POST /user/register, POST /user/login and POST /user/renew-token, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Used to create, list and open branches; a branch token is refused.

BranchBearer.description: Branch token (branch scope) issued by POST /branch/session for one membership, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Role names on a requirement list the branch roles admitted; none listed means any branch role. An identity token is refused.
